column3: NKJV reads “Gadarenes,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Gerasenes.”
NKJV names “Jesus,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “He sent him away.”
NKJV includes “who had spent all her livelihood on physicians,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks this clause.
Close to the Greek; “fringe” is rendered “border.”
NKJV includes “and those with him” and “and You say, ‘Who touched Me?’,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks both.
NKJV includes “be of good cheer,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “Peter, James, and John,” following the Textus Receptus order; the critical text reads “Peter, John, and James.”
NKJV includes “He put them all outside,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
